profile.name: Excel兼容CSV数据导出器
profile.description: 这是一个用于实验室数据记录的软件导出组件，可将测量结果按表格形式追加并写入Excel可打开的CSV文件，便于实验数据归档、共享和离线分析。
profile.description_en: This is a software export component for laboratory data logging. It appends measurement results in tabular form and writes them to Excel-compatible CSV files for archiving, sharing, and offline analysis.

registry.name: Excel-Compatible CSV Handler
registry.description: Excel-Compatible CSV Handler 后处理设备，支持write_data、write_file、reopen、close_file等功能，用于实验室自动化控制与数据采集。
